native_method: Owned T3 incognito tab on old runtime first, real preview_type/click login; first snapshot only after signed-in shell had zero password fields. Closed before builds. New owned incognito tab after builds, second real login, first snapshot after zero password fields. One native tab at a time; no mocks, auth/storage injection, data changes or CSP/CSRF bypass. Native DPR2 probes are not formal DPR1 captures.
contrast_method: Actual idle computed border/fill and ancestor-composited adjacent surface.1x1 detached browser canvas resolves color(srgb)/rgba to sRGB RGBA bytes; alpha composited over actual element fill; standard WCAG sRGB luminance. No PNG color inference. Underlay controls behind a modal excluded. Sampled Busnes light/dark at390x844 and1280x900 only, not all themes/states/elements.
